analyst_view.overall: Brighton (5th of 36, 7 points) host Universitatea Craiova (8th, also 7 points), so a top-eight place is at stake for both. Brighton lost 2-0 at Hull on Sunday and play Newcastle at the weekend, and the latest team-news page expects rotation (only 56% of the eleven kept over six games): Struijk is listed as rested and Azeez out with an abdominal strain, while Minteh, Hadjam, Beadle and Chema Andrés are doubts, none of which the numbers list; Mitoma, Ferguson, Tzimas and Yohanna are out and counted. Craiova, top in Romania, have named the same eleven in their last two games and report no new absences; keeper Isenko's absence is counted, and an earlier report of a muscle problem for forward Monday Etim could not be confirmed today. German referee Matthias Jöllenbeck (5.3 cards a game in three on record) is already counted. I keep a small cut on Brighton's attack for rotation and the extra doubts.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals, 2.8 of them for Brighton, and already take Mitoma, Ferguson and Tzimas into account. A rotated Brighton side with Newcastle next, Minteh doubtful and Azeez out, against a settled, compact Craiova side, points slightly lower, so I go to about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.6 corners, 8.3 of them for Brighton, who should have long spells of possession against a Craiova side that defends deep with wing-backs dropping into a back five. That pattern drives corners whichever Brighton players start, so I stay at 10.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards and already add about 6% for referee Matthias Jöllenbeck, who has shown 5.3 cards a game in his three on record. Craiova will spend long periods defending and pick up the larger share (2.6), which the numbers expect; with no rivalry and no new news on the officials, I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, about 22 for Brighton. Several changes are expected before Newcastle, with Struijk rested, Azeez out and Minteh a doubt, which the numbers can't see, so I trim to about 28.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. A rotated Brighton attack with fewer of its usual creators points a touch lower, so I go to about 10.1; it stays a small lean because Brighton should still create plenty at home.
